facts.fact: SERAP and Sowore's counsel refer to the Cybercrimes Act under which the DSS is prosecuting Sowore; the ECOWAS Court judgment of 2022 concerned the former section 24.

The DSS is prosecuting activist and presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore under the Cybercrimes Act over his description of the President as a criminal, and its Director-General announced on 30 August 2026 that the prosecution would be suspended until after the 2027 election.
